cohort: Women with singleton, full-term breech pregnancies who planned a vaginal breech delivery at a Swiss cantonal hospital (1998-2013)
finding: Peridural anesthesia, nulliparity, high birth weight, and induction of labor were risk factors for unsuccessful vaginal breech delivery requiring an unplanned cesarean section.
mod_finding: Peridural anesthesia, nulliparity, high birth weight, and induction of labor are risk factors for unsuccessful vaginal breech delivery, leading to unplanned cesarean section.
birth_weight: All birth weights reported, with specific analysis on categories and >3250g
